title: Asking for a raise 💸
description:
Asking for a raise. Bubbles sits across from his giant human manager's desk, arms crossed, sliding a crayon-drawn spreadsheet across the table.

"I would like a raise. I accept payment in snacks." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
